description: This file defines the class InstanceCreationHelper within the OrangeHRM\Installer\\Util namespace. It contains static data and methods related to creating and retrieving information about countries, languages, and time zones, primarily used for setting up or configuring the system during installation.

classes.name: InstanceCreationHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static data arrays for countries, languages, and time zones, along with utility methods to retrieve specific information based on codes.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Returns an array of all available time zones with their identifiers and labels.

methods.name: getCountryByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country's details given its country code.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language's details given its language code.
